title: WordPress Philippines Community & Volunteering
description: Active community involvement with WordPress Philippines and the local open-source ecosystem. Began as an attendee in 2025 eager to learn from web engineers and open-source creators. In 2026, stepped forward to serve as an official volunteer photographer documenting major gatherings including Software Freedom Day 2026 Manila ('The Future Is Open', supported by Huawei Cloud Developer Group PH and Digital Freedom Foundation) and the July 2026 WordPress Manila Meetup at Common Ground Don Antonio.
